input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for disruptor event aware processor, disruptor handler, abstract path match event handler. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Content Creator, I want to use disruptor event aware processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use disruptor handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use abstract path match event handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use abstract nameable event handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
